bio: Enjoy 90 minutes of free-flowing wine, with a sweet afternoon tea for two at La Mucca Nera.  What better way to enjoy a day out in Brighton than with a sparkling afternoon tea? Located in the heart of bustling St James’s Street, the fabulous La Mucca Nera boasts Italian passion, with its cheery service and artisanal gelato and sorbets. Dreamy. Sit down for a delicious afternoon tea for two, choosing from freshly baked pastries and creamy cakes, each unique option is as tasty as the last! Cheers to the moment over and over, with 90 minutes of free-flowing bubbles. Delight in your favourite sparkling wine to compliment each luscious sweet taste, before wandering the splendid seafront sands of Brighton.
